intent.outcome: Loading indicators throughout the TUI use a Catppuccin-Mauve-accented braille dot spinner that's visually unmistakable, while the existing 'Loading...' text is preserved.

problem.description: The current spinner is rendered in SubtleText (gray), which makes the loading state visually blend into the background. Users can't tell at a glance that something is loading — empty panels look the same as 'this is broken.'

in_scope: Swap spinner initialization in internal/gui/gui.go from style.SubtleText to a Mauve AccentColor foreground.
Confirm the bubbles/spinner model uses the Dots (braille) frame set: U+283B U+2839 U+2839 U+2838 U+283C U+2834 U+2836 U+2837 U+2837 U+283F U+283F (10-frame cycling).
Apply the AccentColor at the spinner View() call sites in internal/gui/render.go (sidebar title row + main content loading state).
out_of_scope: M14 sidebar polish, log pane, theme swap (separate milestone, must land first).
Spinner animation set change (Dots is the chosen series; not changing).

acceptance_criteria.description: The spinner uses Mauve (Catppuccin AccentColor) foreground instead of SubtleText.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cat internal/gui/gui.go spinner init shows style.AccentText or equivalent; visual: launch lazybrew, observe loading state shows colored spinner

acceptance_criteria.description: The spinner uses the braille Dots animation (10-frame cycling, unicode 0x283B-0x283F range).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cat internal/gui/gui.go spinner model; visual: launch lazybrew during cold cache, observe braille dot cycling

acceptance_criteria.description: Existing 'Loading...' text is preserved alongside the spinner.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: launch lazybrew, observe 'Loading...' text remains next to/below the spinner

design_decisions.rationale: Dots is the bubbles default — most-tested, terminal-portable (braille block chars), and doesn't compete visually with text. AccentColor (Mauve after M14) is bold enough to pop without screaming.

steps.action: In internal/gui/gui.go, change the spinner initialization from style.SubtleText to style.AccentText (or equivalent that resolves to AccentColor / Mauve). Confirm the spinner model is set to the braille Dots series (default for bubbles/spinner).
steps.tests: manual: cat internal/gui/gui.go spinner init; grep for style.AccentText; spinner frames should be braille dots in 0x283B-0x283F range
steps.done_when: Spinner init uses AccentText style; braille Dots frames confirmed in code

steps.action: Confirm spinner View() call sites in internal/gui/render.go still render alongside 'Loading...' text. No change needed if existing code preserves the message; if it was overwritten, restore it.
steps.tests: manual: cat internal/gui/render.go grep spinner.View; visual: launch lazybrew, 'Loading...' text remains visible during load
steps.done_when: Spinner + 'Loading...' text both render at sidebar title row and main content loading sites

steps.action: Run full test suite, gofmt, go vet to confirm M15 doesn't regress.
steps.tests: manual: go test -race ./... exit 0; gofmt -l . empty; go vet ./... clean
